hypothesis.statement: Under a sustained 6 kg elbow-flexion hold, the EMG median frequency declines from start to end (fatigue index < 1), reproducing the De Luca (1984) myoelectric-fatigue law on subject 1 of the Ebied et al. (2021) cohort.

analysis_plan.dataset: Ebied et al. 2021 (Zenodo 5189275) subject 1, 8-channel sEMG @ 200 Hz, 6 kg load, 120 s sustained contraction, 50 Hz notch

decision.threshold: descriptive: fatigue index = final/initial median frequency; < 1 indicates fatigue
